sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
What's new in 4.5.23
- Squarespace stores can now offer Google Pay at checkout, and Apple Pay once it is turned on for the store.
- Checkout and club customization now open full screen above the website's own header, so a sticky header can no longer cover them.
- On Squarespace stores, a signed-in customer now stays signed in across tabs and after closing the browser, instead of being signed out when a link opens a new tab.
- On Squarespace stores, a customer whose session has ended now sees the store as a guest right away, instead of looking signed in with an empty address book and saved cards.
- Winery sites that draw their own Sign In link in the header can now switch it to My Account when a customer is signed in.
